A squeezed light source for Virgo

After more than a year of work a team from @mpi_grav in Hannover and @unihannover@wisskomm.social delivered a squeezed light source to the Virgo detector near Pisa, Italy.

They had constructed it based on prior experience with running a squeezer at GEO600, built it, wrapped it up, and drove it to Virgo themselves where the installed it with their colleagues.

Read the story of their road trip in issue 12 of the LIGO Magazine: https://www.aei.mpg.de/1207011/LIGO-magazine-issue-12.pdf (PDF, page 28 and following)
